summary: Acer Aspire 5 14 (Model: A514-52-50JG) with Intel Core i7-12650H, 16GB DDR5 RAM, and 512GB NVMe SSD is experiencing thermal throttling issues. Proper ventilation, cooling pad or external fan, and power settings adjustments can help mitigate this issue.
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to inadequate cooling system
suggested_solution: Upgrade to a more powerful cooling system or use a cooling pad to maintain optimal temperatures
